text:
The diagram shows a piece of metal resistance wire.
Which wire, made of the same metal, has a smaller resistance?
A
a wire of the same length with a larger diameter
B
a wire of the same length with a smaller diameter
C
a wire of greater length with the same diameter
D
a wire of greater length with a smaller diameter

options.label: A
options.text: a wire of the same length with a larger diameter

options.label: B
options.text: a wire of the same length with a smaller diameter

options.label: C
options.text: a wire of greater length with the same diameter

options.label: D
options.text: a wire of greater length with a smaller diameter
